interface_contract.start_done: start sampled only in IDLE; done held until start deasserts
interface_contract.packed_order: low AXIS beat/byte maps to low native-word slice
interface_contract.mm2s: AXIS64 input to valid-ready 128-bit bank writes
interface_contract.s2mm: valid-ready 1024-bit read request/response to AXIS64 output

behavior.mm2s_abort: discard unpaired half; already offered stalled bank write remains irrevocable through handshake
behavior.s2mm_abort: drain an outstanding untagged response; preserve an already offered stalled AXIS beat through its handshake; then finish
behavior.s2mm_partial: byte_count derives final tkeep and tlast
behavior.stall_stability: request, bank write, and AXIS output payload/sidebands dynamically checked stable

simulation.exact_marker: PASS stream_bank_adapters randomized stalls full partial abort reset repeated no_duplicate
coverage: MM2S lower and upper partial word

verilator.testbench_timing_policy: not supported by installed Verilator; timed self-checking TB executed in XSIM

known_limitations_and_risks: byte offsets are floored to native-word addresses; MM2S commands must be 16-byte aligned and S2MM commands 128-byte aligned
post-synthesis OOC timing is not routed integration timing
S2MM deliberately prioritizes protocol simplicity over prefetch throughput: only one word is requested and fully serialized at a time
no error response exists on the frozen bank response interface; unexpected rsp_valid while no request is outstanding is ignored
